task: z-fighting chao (island_underside coplanar with Terrain and with each other)
author: Gaia
method: Uniform drop of every island_underside part (whole models, *_01 and *_02) by 0.3 stud from the original position. Tops go from Y=0 to Y=-0.3, about 0.28 below the Terrain surface (Y~-0.02). Only downward moves. Paths/bridge, spawns, markers and HealPoint untouched. A raycast check (10682 rays) found no area where the pieces remain the visible surface, so no extra staggering was needed.
notes: childIndex = 1-based index of the island_underside model in Workspace.Map.Collision.underside:GetChildren() order; use matchPositionXZ + orientationY to match pieces in the source JSON.
Backup in place: ServerStorage.GaiaZFightBackup_20261107 (218 models / 436 MeshParts, original CFrames, attribute GaiaZF_Index). Each changed part has attribute GaiaZF_DeltaY = -0.3.
This replaces an earlier layered pass (0.1-0.3 on 138 pieces) that was superseded on the same night; all values here are relative to the original positions.
